order_book: The kind of order book that we already have in place right now really support that claim that we are making that we will certainly be able to achieve our targeted growth of 50 to 60% under the Design & Build vertical.
And that is primarily because of the kind of order book that we already have, which is more than 300 crores plus.
guidance: Do we expect any improvement for the next 2 quarters?
Yes, I mean, we have set a target of 50 to 60%, and that is a target that we all are geared up to achieve.
capex: And at Furniture Manufacturing at an optimal manufacturing capacity, again, around 24%, 25%.
risks: Before we proceed with this call, I would like to mention that some of the stateme nts made in today's call may be forward-looking in nature and may involve risks and uncertainties.

focus: EFC asset -light leasing model, which does not depend on ownership of the underlying real estate allow us to address this evolving re quirement while maintaining a focus on scalability and capital efficiency.
During Q2 FY27, we continue to focus on strengthening our operation across Leasing, Design & Build an d Furniture Manufacturing.
We believe that the investments we are making in this vertical can help us create a stronger and more diversified manufacturing platform over time.
quals: We are not depen dent on a single business or a single source of growth.
